title: A compressor declared on/off (compressor_modulation=on_off) is planned as modulating; on switch+setpoint it removes the clamp
claim: With compressor_modulation=on_off, thermal_model.declared_modulation returns True (modulating), so the published plan is never projected onto {0} U [p_min, p_max]: 0 of 10 grid cells clamp, 8 of 10 publish steps in (0, p_min), and on an unmetered switch+setpoint plant the declaration turns the probe's clamp (10/10 cells) off (0/10).
mechanism: declared_modulation maps COMPRESSOR_MODULATION_ON_OFF to True, the value its docstring and the modulating branch reserve for 'modulating'; duty_cycle_realizable then short-circuits to True, levels_clamped to False, and OptimizationConfig.from_mapping solves with clamp_planned_levels=False; probe_install.on_off (declared_modulation(cfg) is False) is also never set.

evidence.unit: grid cells (of 10) whose on_off-declared plan is clamped (RESULT on_off_clamped_cells); on_off_sub_min_total=132 steps, on_off_cells_failing=8
evidence.machine: box B6, Linux x86_64, python 3.14, numpy 2.5.4, scipy 1.18.1
evidence.contention_note: two other compute seats on B6 (load1 4-13); counts are contention-immune
evidence.tolerance: exact for clamped cells; +-10 for sub_min_total (solver warm-start)

perturbation.change: --perturb doc-modulation: mock.patch.object(thermal_model, 'declared_modulation', the docstring's map, on_off -> False); one-line production equivalent: 'False if mode == const.COMPRESSOR_MODULATION_ON_OFF' in declared_modulation

metric_definition: Per price x weather cell, plan steps whose total electrical level (space+DHW) lies in (0, p_min) in the plan one real cycle publishes for a plant declaring compressor_modulation=on_off.
phenomenon_property: A compressor mode the user declares (on_off / modulating) is the mode the plan obeys on every write surface: on_off always projects planned levels onto {0} U [p_min, p_max], and no declaration makes the plan less constrained than the undeclared probe.

null_control.command: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D12/s3/modulation.py  (arms modulating, absent, switch_setpoint_absent); and surfaces.py --reference

null_control.note: Not a cost claim; --flat still shows on_off 35 sub-min steps, switch_setpoint_on_off 35 vs switch_setpoint_absent 0.

run modulation.py; read RESULT on_off_clamped_cells=0 and switch_setpoint_on_off_clamped_cells=0 vs switch_setpoint_absent_clamped_cells=10
run modulation.py --perturb doc-modulation; every on_off count goes to 0 / clamped 10
proposed_fix_scope: thermal_model.declared_modulation: map COMPRESSOR_MODULATION_ON_OFF to False; tests/features.py's #3289 block already states that expectation
